The '''New Republic Antiquities Office''' was a branch of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Any individual discovering a [[Shrine of Kooroo]] was requested to report the find to the Antiquities Office.<ref name="FFCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
